title: TESTER-EST-01
description: Refinish 300 sqft pool with PebbleTec, replace 45 linft of coping, install 2 pool lights

line_items.description: PebbleTec pool refinishing - drain, prep, acid wash, and apply PebbleTec finish
Labor for pool draining, surface preparation, and PebbleTec application
Remove existing coping and install new cantilevered or paver coping (material + labor)
Labor for coping removal and installation including mortar bed and grouting
Supply and install LED pool light fixtures (2 ea) including niche, conduit, and wiring
Electrician labor for pool light installation, wiring, and GFCI connection
Municipal permit fees for pool renovation/electrical work (AZ typical)
Water delivery to refill pool post-refinish (estimated 15,000 gal residential pool)
Pool startup chemical treatment and balancing after PebbleTec cure
Equipment rental: jackhammer, mixer, water pump for drain and prep

upsells.title: Color-Changing LED Light Upgrade
upsells.description: Upgrade standard white LED pool lights to Pentair or Hayward color-changing RGB LED fixtures with wireless controller for ambiance lighting effects.
upsells.rationale: Customer is already replacing lights; marginal cost to upgrade to color-changing LEDs is low relative to total project and significantly increases nighttime enjoyment and home value appeal.

upsells.title: Waterline Pool Tile Replacement
upsells.description: Replace existing waterline tile (est. 45 linft) with new glass or porcelain mosaic tile to complement new PebbleTec finish and fresh coping.
upsells.rationale: Pool is already drained for refinishing, making this the ideal and most cost-effective time to replace waterline tile. Mismatched old tile against new PebbleTec finish is aesthetically inconsistent.

upsells.title: Variable Speed Pump Upgrade
upsells.description: Replace existing single-speed pump with an energy-efficient variable speed pump (Pentair IntelliFlo or equivalent) to meet AZ utility rebate requirements and reduce energy costs.
upsells.rationale: APS and SRP offer rebates on variable speed pumps in AZ. Customer can save up to 80% on pump energy costs. Pool is already being serviced making this an efficient time to upgrade.

upsells.title: Travertine Paver Deck Overlay
upsells.description: Install natural travertine or cool-deck paver overlay around pool perimeter (est. 400 sqft) to coordinate with new coping and provide a cooler, slip-resistant surface.
upsells.rationale: New coping installation exposes the transition between coping and existing deck. An updated deck surface ties the renovation together and increases property value in the AZ market.

upsells.title: Automatic Pool Cleaner / Robotic Vacuum
upsells.description: Supply and install a robotic pool cleaner (e.g., Dolphin or Polaris) to protect the new PebbleTec finish from debris accumulation and reduce manual maintenance.
upsells.rationale: PebbleTec surfaces require consistent cleaning to maintain appearance and warranty. A robotic cleaner reduces labor and prevents staining, preserving the investment in the new finish.
